units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 11:1:6">Y. Yeb. XI, 11ᵈ</cite> top. <he>א׳ זכר</he> the mother of the male side, father-in-law’s mother; <he>א׳ נקבה</he> mother-in-law’s mother.

senses.gloss: substance, bulk, as the cluster of olives (contrad. to leaves); the starting point of leprosy.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:8">Toh. IX, 8</cite> <he>אם היה נוגע בא׳</he> if the reptile touched the cluster.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:5">Neg. I, 5</cite> <he>הלכה לה הא׳</he> the original leprosy has disappeared.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> end, Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A01961"><he>אֵם</he></cite>).
